styleLock.direction: warm cozy baby winter clothing commerce

styleLock.lightingSystem: bright warm high-key studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: clean white tabletop #FFFFFF and light warm wood accents
styleLock.typography: rounded child-friendly sans-serif headlines in charcoal with orange #F08300 highlights
styleLock.iconSystem: solid rounded icons in circles, single orange accent #F08300, low complexity

styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm baby winter clothing visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of marigold yellow #FFD400 banner panels, warm off-white #FFF7E8, clean white #FFFFFF backgrounds, pastel product tones, and one vivid orange accent #F08300; bright warm high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and soft contact shadows; rounded child-friendly sans-serif headlines; consistent rounded rectangular info labels; consistent solid rounded icons in the accent color; clean product photography on plain white hangers and soft tabletops mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable front-facing product presentation with consistent scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 从 13 张婴幼儿夹棉三件套爆款长图切片提炼；已剥离源品牌字与 logo、婴儿模特照片、检测报告原件、原文案与装饰性英文句子，产品一律以 {product} 呈现，尺码与规格数值由生成时供给；儿童仅保留上身展示角色，采用裁切构图不露脸；信任镜不设任何证书或徽章占位，以夹棉截面、走线与按扣等可验证视觉细节承载可信感。
